text_zh: 一盒鸡蛋有 6 个。两盒鸡蛋一共有几个？
text_en: One box holds 6 eggs. How many eggs are there in two boxes?

text_zh: 一辆小汽车有 4 个轮子。4 辆小汽车一共有几个轮子？
text_en: A car has 4 wheels. How many wheels do 4 cars have altogether?

text_zh: 小明把 9 块红色积木和 7 块蓝色积木排成一排。后来弄丢了 3 块红色积木。这一排还剩几块积木？
text_en: Xiaoming lines up 9 red blocks and 7 blue blocks in a row. Later 3 red blocks get lost. How many blocks are left in the row?
explanation_en: There were 9 + 7 = 16 blocks at first; 3 are lost, so 16 − 3 = 13 remain.

text_zh: 小红看一本故事书，从第 10 页看到第 18 页。她一共看了几页？
text_en: Xiaohong reads a storybook from page 10 to page 18. How many pages does she read in all?

text_zh: 给一本书编页码，从第 1 页编到第 12 页。一共要写出几个数字？（比如第 10 页要写出“1”和“0”两个数字）
text_en: A book's pages are numbered from 1 to 12. How many digits are written in all? (For example, page 10 uses two digits: “1” and “0”.)
explanation_zh: 第 1～9 页每页 1 个数字，共 9 个；第 10、11、12 页每页 2 个数字，共 6 个。9 + 6 = 15 个。
explanation_en: Pages 1–9 use 1 digit each (9 digits); pages 10, 11, 12 use 2 digits each (6 digits). 9 + 6 = 15 digits.
